name: review-scope-late-arrival
title: Close the pack.review-scope late-arrival gap for mixed diffs
description: The pack.review-scope gate requires a scope heading only once the branch diff contains a scoped file, but sd-ship Stage 2b's finalization adds the journal/index files that trigger it after the PR body is authored. --prepare-tooling-body declines to help on a mixed diff, so the failure lands on the successor-head re-entry. Observed on PRs #156, #163, #172, #203, and #208. Remedy lands upstream in platypeeps/sd-ai-command-pack; this repository owns only the spec update and a disposition record.
creator: sdelmas
